notes.title: Hotkeys and audio cues
notes.content: [p]You´ve been asking for it, so we´re happy to add more![/p][p][/p][p]With the last update, we´ve added hotkeys and customization options.[/p][p][/p][p]This change makes the gameply significantly more dynamic, for both newcomers and veterans![/p][p]we´ve also added more audio cues for the game over conditions. This way, you won´t miss a thing if you´re distracted by raiding the planet.[/p][p][/p][p][b]A tiny change with a big impact: No more missplacements![/b][/p][p]We´ve introduced a temporary placement lock for new spaceships on the battlefield while it´s moving. This way you won´t missplace a spaceship anymore![/p]

notes.title: Release notes 8/15/2025
notes.content:
-New audio clues for getting close to lose conditions
-Keybindings for gameplay
-Keybinding options
-Short placement lock while the field is moving inserted - prevents misplacements

notes.title: "Pilot Manual"
notes.content: [p]The "Pilot Manual" is here![/p][p][/p][p]We realize that getting started with [i]Project Fleet[/i] can sometimes be a bit bumpy. This is partly because [i]Project Fleet[/i] is a unique game with few comparables. Second, we haven't provided enough information to help new players successfully raid planets.[/p][p][/p][p]We've heard your feedback and are proud to present the new "Pilot Manual":[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634506/115b61cf3d45e51e42f9c525db015b78cb2f62be.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]In the Expeditions section of Story Mode, you'll now find the "Pilot Manual."[/p][p][/p][p]It contains a beginner's guide with the basics of spaceships, formations, fleet management, enemy planets, and detailed information on events.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope the "Pilot Manual" makes it easier for you to get started and helps you unlock your fleet's full potential.[/p][p][/p][p]-ArntWorks Development[/p]
